Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
Urinalysis shows significant pyuria, bacteriuria, positive nitrites, and hematuria, with >100,000 CFU/mL E. coli cultured, indicating a urinary tract infection. Low specific gravity may suggest dilute urine. No ketones or casts detected. Recommend clinical correlation and consideration of appropriate antibiotic therapy.
